rows.description: After a big fight, neither of us wants to speak first. Pride is the barrier. The wiser one offers a small gesture like sharing a snack. Saying sorry does not mean I lose; it means I value us.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: affection, anger, dependence, favouritism, guilt, protectiveness

rows.description: My heart jumps when she walks in and I cannot speak. A crush is a new, warm feeling and nothing to be ashamed of. Wise: be friendly, keep it light, and do not stare or follow her.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: compassion, fear, mockery, rejection, respect, rivalry

rows.description: I write his name on the last page of my notebook and hope nobody sees. Keeping the feeling private is fine. If I tell someone, choose a kind friend who will not spread it.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: compassion, fear, mockery, rejection, respect, rivalry

rows.description: Classmates tease me that a boy likes me, and I go red. His feelings are his own and I do not have to feel the same. I can say thanks for being nice, but I am not thinking about that, and stay kind.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: compassion, fear, mockery, rejection, respect, rivalry

rows.description: I found out my crush likes someone else and my chest feels heavy. This ache is real, though it will pass. Wise: cry if needed, talk to someone, stay friends if I can. Mocking him or the other kid does not help.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: compassion, fear, mockery, respect, rivalry, shame

rows.description: I like her, but I know she may not like me back, and that is okay. Respecting her feelings means I never push, follow or pester. Liking someone does not give me any claim over them.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: compassion, fear, mockery, rejection, rivalry, shame

rows.description: My friends chant our names together and I feel humiliated. I can say stop, that is not fun for me. Real friends stop when asked. Teasing about a crush can hurt both children and spoil a friendship.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: compassion, fear, rejection, respect, rivalry, shame
related mind states: playfulness, humiliation, hurt

rows.description: I think he is perfect and daydream all class. Early crushes are often made of imagination. Wise: enjoy the feeling and notice the real person, including flaws. Do not change myself just to be liked.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: compassion, fear, mockery, rejection, respect, rivalry

rows.description: My mother finds a note and laughs or gets angry, and I feel exposed. A good parent stays calm, says it is natural, and talks about respect and boundaries. I can ask that they keep it private.

rows.description: My best friend likes the same boy and we both feel odd. I can be honest that this is awkward and agree our friendship matters more. Fighting over him spoils something bigger.
